name: GovGazette
tagline: Research federal contracts with dated source links
description: Search federal contracting opportunities, research awards and vendors, and review exclusion evidence with dated official-source links over Streamable HTTP. Exposes 17 MCP tools (`check_exclusions`, `create_saved_search`, `delete_saved_search`, `delete_saved_search_workspace`, `detail`, `document`, `exclusion_changes`, `exclusion_context`, `explain_match`, `freshness`, `get_saved_search_events`, `list_saved_searches`, `research_opportunity`, `rotate_saved_search_feed`, `search`, `search_exclusions`, `search_opportunities`). Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

install.notes: Public research works without a key. Private saved-search actions require a GovGazette workspace key.
